result.title: ROCOCO: Robust Outline Completion of Occluded Curvilinear Objects
result.summary: We propose a learning-based generative model for completing curvilinear features under occlusion by environmental obstacles. To this end, we adopt a flow matching-based approach that supports the inpainting of occluded regions with the appropriate curvilinear features. To eliminate the reliance on privileged information about the occlusion a priori, we also train a UNet-based mask prediction model, which can identify regions for inpainting given only the occluded observation. The components of our approach are validated via experiments using procedurally-generated test cases, and the complete pipeline is validated using large public datasets for curvilinear objects. Against off-the-shelf inpainting baselines, ROCOCO is the strongest method by a wide margin when no occlusion mask is given, and is competitive with mask-supervised inpainting when one is, achieving best on full-image error and second only to LaMa on the occluded region, while using a completer of $7.7$M parameters against LaMa's $51$M and Stable Diffusion's $860$M.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 ROCOCO，用 flow matching 生成模型补全被环境障碍遮挡的曲线特征，并训练 UNet 掩码预测模型，使其仅凭遮挡后观测即可定位需补全区域，在程序生成用例与公开曲线物体数据集上验证。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「不给先验遮挡掩码、由模型自行判断何处需补全」的模块与遮挡下的几何特征恢复，可能为 LVR 中判断哪些视觉区域尚需补充证据、如何避免几何细节缺失提供概念线索，需核查是否可迁移。
